rationale: Successor experiment for the wedge investigation that measures the margin generalization recorded with it. The harness is unchanged for the three-voter cases and now also runs the same staging on five voters in both the control and the faulted mode, removing healthy voters one at a time and applying a client entry after each removal, so the step at which commit stops can be compared between the control and the wedged cluster. Native local feedback in a scratch copy inside draft showed the control committing after two removals while the faulted five-voter cluster committed after one removal and stalled at the second, but the retained execution decides.

experiment.revision_reason: Same investigation and staging, with the voter count and the number of escalation steps parameterized so that five-voter control and faulted cases run the same legal partition/divergence/higher-term replacement history and then lose healthy voters one at a time; the earlier receipts remain the witnesses for the three-voter windows and the restart path.

scope.description: Five subtests share one harness: control and injected_store_error on three voters with one escalation step, injected_store_error_then_restart on three voters, and control_five_voters and injected_store_error_five_voters on five voters with two escalation steps. Each case builds the cluster from the library's own in-memory components with a legal fault-injecting LogStore wrapper on the node that becomes the initial leader, runs the partition/divergence/higher-term-replacement history, heals, samples the certificate and store for 1500 ms, removes the fault and samples once more, then removes one healthy voter per step (disconnecting it in both directions) and applies one client entry per step while recording the leader's commit index over 1500 ms, whether that apply future completes, its error, and the leader's and the wedged node's probes with every node's state and term.
assumptions: Removing a healthy voter at the transport level models that voter failing; the remaining voters keep their membership in the configuration, so the quorum size stays the configuration's quorum.
The wedged replica stays connected in every step, because it must keep receiving the leader's retries for the margin claim to be about the wedge rather than about an unreachable node.
A LogStore returning an error from StoreLogs is an allowed outcome of the interface, and the wrapper returns it without touching the underlying store.
The control and faulted five-voter cases differ only in whether that one StoreLogs call returned an error.
excluded: No production code is modified and no fault other than the single store error is injected.
No restart, snapshot install or leader-side compaction is exercised in this experiment; the restart path is covered by the earlier receipt.

experiment.prefix: Each subtest prints the CA_EVENT lines described before; peer_loss_after_wedge now carries mode, step, voters (the configuration size), removed_voter, leader, leader_state, leader_term, commit_before, commit_samples over 1500 ms, apply_future_done, apply_future_error, leader_probe, wedged_node_probe and state_and_term.
